moa: selective inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor receptors 1, 2 and 3 (VEGFR-1/2/3) tyrosine kinases

approval_evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of FRUZAQLA (fruquintinib) capsules for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) who have been previously treated with fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan based chemotherapy, an anti-VEGF therapy, and, if RAS wild type and medically appropriate, an anti-EGFR therapy. (FDA approval letter, NDA 217564)

launch_evidence.quote: Sales of FRUZAQLA (for colorectal cancer), which newly launched in November 2023 in the U.S., were JPY 10.1 billion.

notes: Scope is the U.S. column of Takeda's Fruzaqla row (first regional column, headed 'US', of the three-month product sales table), JPY billions to one decimal at actual exchange rates. U.S. was chosen over the worldwide total because the total changes composition: Takeda's FY2024 Q2 report shows non-U.S. revenue for the first time in the Europe column (1.0 of 11.1 in the quarter; the European Commission approval was announced in June 2024 and the Japanese approval in September 2024), with Japan, Europe and Other columns growing afterwards (U.S. 7.6 of 12.2 in FY2025 Q4). The first two quarters (2023Q4, 2024Q1) are read from the prior-year columns of the FY2024 Q1 quarterly trend table (total), since Takeda's FY2023 reports print no quarterly Fruzaqla line, only the full year 10.1; Fruzaqla was marketed only in the U.S. in FY2023 (FY2023 Q3 report: 'FRUZAQLA [marketed in the U.S.'), and the FY2024 Q3 and Q4 three-month rows show U.S. equal to the total prior-year figure (U.S. 10.5 and 8.9, total prior year 2.2 and 7.8, at +368.4 and +13.3 percent). Quarters of FY2023 add to 10.0 against a printed 10.1, and FY2024 U.S. quarters add to 41.4 against the printed 41.4.
